package_managers.pip:
# Python — install deps
RUN if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip3 install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt; fi
package_managers.pip (pyproject):
# Python — install from pyproject.toml
RUN if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip3 install --no-cache-dir .; fi
package_managers.pipenv:
# Python — install via Pipenv
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir pipenv \
 && if [ -f Pipfile ]; then pipenv install --system --deploy; fi
package_managers.poetry:
# Python — install via Poetry
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir poetry \
 && if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then poetry install --no-interaction; fi

node.toolchain:
# Node.js LTS (via NodeSource)
RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x | bash - \
    && apt-get install -y nodejs

package_managers.npm:
# Node — install deps
RUN if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi
package_managers.yarn:
# Node — install via Yarn
RUN npm install -g yarn \
 && if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn install --frozen-lockfile; fi
package_managers.pnpm:
# Node — install via pnpm
RUN npm install -g pnpm \
 && if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; fi

typescript.toolchain:
# Node.js LTS (via NodeSource)
RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x | bash - \
    && apt-get install -y nodejs

package_managers.npm:
# Node/TS — install deps
RUN if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi
package_managers.yarn:
# Node/TS — install via Yarn
RUN npm install -g yarn \
 && if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn install --frozen-lockfile; fi
package_managers.pnpm:
# Node/TS — install via pnpm
RUN npm install -g pnpm \
 && if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; fi

go.toolchain:
# Go toolchain
RUN curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.22.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz \
    | tar -C /usr/local -xz
ENV PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin

package_managers.go modules:
# Go — download modules
RUN if [ -f go.mod ]; then go mod download; fi

rust.toolchain:
# Rust toolchain (rustup)
RUN curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y
ENV PATH=$PATH:/root/.cargo/bin

package_managers.cargo:
# Rust — prefetch crate registry
RUN if [ -f Cargo.toml ]; then cargo fetch; fi

package_managers.bundler:
# Ruby — install gems
RUN if [ -f Gemfile ]; then gem install bundler --no-document && bundle install; fi

package_managers.maven:
# Java — resolve Maven dependencies
RUN if [ -f pom.xml ]; then mvn dependency:resolve -q; fi
package_managers.gradle:
# Java — resolve Gradle dependencies
RUN if [ -f build.gradle ]; then gradle dependencies -q; fi

package_managers.maven:
# Kotlin — resolve Maven dependencies
RUN if [ -f pom.xml ]; then mvn dependency:resolve -q; fi
package_managers.gradle:
# Kotlin — resolve Gradle dependencies
RUN if [ -f build.gradle ] || [ -f build.gradle.kts ]; then gradle dependencies -q; fi

php.toolchain:
# PHP Composer
RUN curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer \
    | php -- --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer

package_managers.composer:
# PHP — install composer packages
RUN if [ -f composer.json ]; then composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader; fi

dotnet.toolchain:
# .NET SDK
RUN curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh \
    | bash /dev/stdin --channel 8.0
ENV PATH=$PATH:/root/.dotnet:/root/.dotnet/tools

package_managers.nuget:
# .NET — restore packages
RUN if ls *.csproj 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then dotnet restore; fi
